This policy explains what personal data is processed when you visit nextgenwargame.com, which is a static website: it has no user accounts, forms, comments, or newsletter.

## 2. Hosting

This website is hosted by Netlify, Inc., San Francisco, USA. When you visit the site, your browser connects to Netlify's servers, and Netlify processes the technical data listed in section 3 to deliver the pages.

Netlify is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Data transferred to Netlify in the USA is therefore covered by the European Commission's adequacy decision of 10 July 2023 (Art. 45 GDPR).

Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. My legitimate interest is delivering the website securely and reliably.

## 3. Server Log Files

Each time a page is requested, the hosting servers automatically record:

a. your IP address;\
b. date and time of the request;\
c. the page or file requested;\
d. the referring page, if your browser sends one;\
e. browser type and operating system (user agent).

These data are used only to deliver the site, keep it secure, and find errors. They are not combined with other data and are not used to identify you. Netlify deletes them after its standard retention period.

Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

## 4. Cookies, Analytics, and Tracking

This website sets no cookies and uses no analytics, tracking, advertising, or social media plugins.

## 5. Fonts

All fonts are stored on this website's own server. Your browser does not contact Google Fonts or any other font service.

## 6. Contact by Email

If you email me, I process your email address, your name if given, and the content of your message to answer you. My email is provided by Google (Gmail); Google LLC is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. I delete messages when they are no longer needed for the conversation, unless legal retention duties apply.

Please do not send sensitive personal, operational, legal, medical, financial, or proprietary information in a first message.

Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (answering your inquiry), or Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR if your message concerns a contract or steps before one.

## 7. External Links

This website links to other sites: LinkedIn, taijeronv.info, and the CADE App at app.nextgenwargame.com. The CADE App is a separate service and is not covered by this policy. No data is sent to those sites unless you click a link. Once you leave this website, the other site's privacy policy applies.

## 8. Your Rights

Under the GDPR you have the right to:

a. access the personal data I hold about you (Art. 15);\
b. correct inaccurate data (Art. 16);\
c. have your data deleted (Art. 17);\
d. restrict processing (Art. 18);\
e. receive your data in a portable format (Art. 20);\
f. object to processing based on Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, on grounds relating to your particular situation (Art. 21).

To use these rights, email me at the address in section 1.
